name: Clara's Love Hotel
source:
Clara manages the Love Hotel, an exclusive house of ill repute catering to those with very explicit tastes! Always on the lookout for new recruits, she tempts greedy, horny girls to lose their innocence in her world of sex for money, perverted wealth, and dangerous, erotic games. 

Join Clara and her girls on their journey of new experiences, sexual opportunities, and crazy rich clients in this lewdest of enterprises. Welcome to the Love Hotel - but only if you can afford it!

[From Itch.io]
translation:
克拉拉經營著「情人旅館」，一家專為口味極其露骨的客人服務的高級風月場所！她總在物色新人，引誘貪婪而慾求不滿的女性，在她那個以性換錢、財富腐化、情慾遊戲又充滿危險的世界裡失去純真。

跟隨克拉拉與她的姑娘們，在這門淫靡至極的生意中，體驗新鮮經歷、尋找性愛機會，接待那些瘋狂的富豪客人。歡迎來到情人旅館——前提是，你付得起錢！

[摘自Itch.io]
